headline: Nigerian Naira Faces Pressure From Importer Dollar Demand
summary: The Nigerian naira faces depreciation pressure as corporate importers increase foreign-exchange purchases and market participants take profits ahead of year-end demand.
why: Currency fluctuations in Nigeria influence domestic inflation, consumer purchasing power, and central bank foreign-exchange policy.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: Heightened importer demand for US dollars outstrips FX liquidity, putting downward pressure on the naira.
